topic: How should an open-source developer-tools project reduce time-to-first-successful-run for new users (the time from `git clone` to a working demo)?

angles.name: practitioner
angles.description: An engineer who installs OSS dev tools weekly and has a low frustration tolerance. What kills momentum for them?

angles.name: contrarian
angles.description: Deliberately oppose the common 'add more docs' instinct. What if more docs is the WRONG fix?

angles.name: analogist
angles.description: Different field — how do videogames onboard new players in 60 seconds? How does Stripe make signing up feel inevitable? Borrow from there.
